entities.name: Xerex
entities.description: A plane of enormous underground passages with Escherian, kaleidoscopic geometry.

entities.name: Etched Host
entities.description: The only Phyrexian faction not to make an incursion on Xerex.

events.summary: Most Phyrexian factions invade Xerex but fail because its nebulous reality is too alien for them to comprehend.
events.quote: the nebulous reality in Xerex was too alien for the literalist Phyrexians to comprehend
